text.tspan: Fast. When this resolves, choose a Wormhole
with an endpoint at a Planet you control;
defines Restriction) on it naming yourself, so
the opposing challenger's Assaults may not

The Panoptic Concord doesn't need to fight for
a route once it already knows which route
matters — it simply writes its own name on the
